disorder-name.detail: Autism Spectrum Disorder; Clinical Cohort applied to NM built from typically developed (TD) controls. Participants aged 5–40 years from the ABIDE dataset.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Using a world-wide multi-site database known as Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange, we analyzed individuals with ASD and typically developed (TD) controls (total n = 1218) aged 5-40 years"

dataset-of-origin.detail: The paper uses the ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) dataset without explicitly specifying ABIDE-I or ABIDE-II. The supplement states 1495 individuals from 17 data acquisition centers were included before exclusions. After quality-based exclusion: 576 ASD + 642 TD = 1218 total.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "All the data analyzed in this study were sourced from the ABIDE dataset."
dataset-of-origin.location: S0033291724000138sup001.docx.md: Online supplement 1 Dataset details, L3; Jiang2024.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L92

age.detail: From Table 1 for the ASD group (N=576). SD reported as 7.786 in table; rounded to 7.79 per 2 d.p. convention.
age.location: Jiang2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / Table 1, L77–L80

sex.detail: Exact sex counts not reported in Table 1 or supplementary materials. Estimated from 'male-to-female ratio of approximately 5:1' stated in Limitations with N=576 ASD. Male = 576 × 5/6 ≈ 480; Female = 576 × 1/6 ≈ 96. Values are estimates; percentages computed from estimated counts.
sex.supporting_text: "it also has few female participants, with a male-to-female ratio of approximately 5:1"
sex.location: Jiang2024.pdf.md: Discussion / Limitations and future directions, L226
